text_a: Marta envió el informe a los auditores.
text_b: Marta ha enviado el informe a los auditores.
what_differs: Simple past vs present perfect; in Spanish they may or may not differ in relevance to the present.

text_a: The system sends a reminder to every customer.
text_b: The system will send a reminder to every customer.
what_differs: Habitual present vs future: one describes current behavior, the other a not-yet-happened event.

text_a: A equipe enviará o contrato amanhã.
text_b: A equipe vai enviar o contrato amanhã.

text_a: El proveedor envía la factura al cierre de mes.
text_b: The supplier has sent the invoice at month end.
what_differs: Habitual present vs completed past action.

text_a: Upload the file before the deadline.
text_b: Upload the files before the deadline.
what_differs: One file vs multiple files.

text_a: Cada archivo debe pasar la revisión de seguridad.
text_b: Todos los archivos deben pasar la revisión de seguridad.

text_a: Revise o relatório antes de enviá-lo ao cliente.
text_b: Revise os relatórios antes de enviá-los ao cliente.
what_differs: Singular vs plural report; context might imply a single report is meant generically.

text_a: Each attachment must be under 5 MB.
text_b: All attachments together must be under 5 MB.
what_differs: Per-item limit vs aggregate limit.

text_a: Discount applies to 10% of the stock.
text_b: Discount applies to one in ten items in stock.

text_a: Se reasignará la mitad de los casos abiertos.
text_b: Se reasignarán 50 casos abiertos.
what_differs: Half of cases is relative; 50 cases is an absolute number that may not equal half.

text_a: Cerca de um terço dos usuários migrou para o novo plano.
text_b: Cerca de 33% dos usuários migrou para o novo plano.

text_a: Reduce the batch by 10 units.
text_b: Reduce the batch by 10%.
what_differs: Absolute reduction vs relative reduction.

text_a: Anyone with the link can view the document.
text_b: Everyone can view the document.
what_differs: Link-holders vs everyone; 'everyone' may or may not imply link is needed.

text_a: Solo los administradores pueden aprobar gastos.
text_b: Todos excepto los miembros pueden aprobar gastos.
what_differs: Admins only vs everyone except members (could include owners, guests, etc.).

text_a: Somente os proprietários podem remover usuários.
text_b: Apenas os donos têm permissão para remover usuários.

text_a: Members can edit the page; owners can also delete it.
text_b: Only owners can edit or delete the page.
what_differs: Members' edit permission present vs absent.

text_a: Mueve el archivo a la papelera.
text_b: Elimina el archivo permanentemente.
what_differs: Recoverable trash vs permanent deletion.

text_a: This action cannot be undone.
text_b: This action is irreversible.

text_a: Arquive o projeto ao terminar.
text_b: Exclua o projeto ao terminar.
what_differs: Archiving preserves data; deleting removes it.

text_a: Archived records can be restored within the system.
text_b: Records moved to the archive are not permanently removed.
what_differs: Restorable via system vs merely not permanently removed; restore capability not guaranteed in the second.

text_a: The patch will fix the login bug.
text_b: The patch is guaranteed to fix the login bug.
what_differs: Plain future assertion vs explicit guarantee; strength of commitment arguably differs.

text_a: Probablemente la entrega llegue el viernes.
text_b: Se espera que la entrega llegue el viernes.

text_a: A migração pode causar lentidão.
text_b: A migração vai causar lentidão.
what_differs: Possibility vs certainty.

text_a: This should be fine for production.
text_b: This is ready for production.
what_differs: Hedged expectation vs flat assertion of readiness.

text_a: The outage was confirmed by the vendor.
text_b: The outage was reportedly caused by the vendor.
what_differs: Confirmed fact vs unverified report; also confirmation vs causation.

text_a: Según el registro, el usuario accedió a las 3:00.
text_b: Como consta en el log, el usuario accedió a las 3:00.

text_a: Supostamente, o pagamento foi recebido na segunda.
text_b: O pagamento foi recebido na segunda, segundo o banco.
what_differs: Unsourced allegation vs attributed to a named source.

text_a: Allegedly, the file was modified after the audit.
text_b: Reportedly, the file was modified after the audit.
what_differs: 'Allegedly' implies accusation; 'reportedly' implies hearsay; overlap is debatable.

text_a: Prueba la conexión una vez más.
text_b: Prueba la conexión otra vez.

text_a: Run the backup twice.
text_b: Run the backup every time the server restarts.
what_differs: Fixed count of two vs recurring on each restart.

text_a: Tente entrar novamente.
text_b: Tente entrar duas vezes.
what_differs: Retry (at least once more) vs exactly two attempts.

text_a: Please confirm one more time.
text_b: Please confirm again.
what_differs: 'Again' may mean repeat indefinitely or once; 'one more time' implies exactly one extra.

text_a: The report is due at 9am.
text_b: The report is due at 9:00 UTC.
what_differs: Unspecified (likely local) time vs explicit UTC.

text_a: Responde antes del mediodía.
text_b: Responde antes de las 12:00 hora local.

text_a: Entregue até o fim do dia.
text_b: Entregue até as 18h.
what_differs: End of day is vague and may extend past 18h (e.g., midnight).

text_a: Call us during business hours.
text_b: Call us between 9am and 5pm.
what_differs: Business hours may differ from 9-5 by company and timezone.

text_a: Cancela la reunión del jueves.
text_b: Pospón la reunión del jueves.
what_differs: Cancel removes the meeting; postpone moves it to later.

text_a: Issue a refund to the customer.
text_b: Issue store credit to the customer.
what_differs: Refund returns money; credit is usable only in store.

text_a: Suspenda a conta do cliente.
text_b: Bloqueie temporariamente a conta do cliente.

text_a: The manager approved the request.
text_b: The manager acknowledged the request.
what_differs: Approval grants consent; acknowledgment only confirms receipt.
